Bergmite

Ice

Kalos · Generation 6

Bergmite is an Ice-type Ice Chunk Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 99.5 kg. It evolves into Avalugg. Its highest base stat is Defense (85), with a base stat total of 304.
